property_summary: After any Put call, the stored unlockTime must be at least the current block.timestamp (the contract never shortens the lock to a past time); the mutant stores the raw _unlockTime, so a past _unlockTime yields unlockTime < block.timestamp.
change_summary: Replace the unlockTime update with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` so a past _unlockTime can shorten the lock instead of keeping block.timestamp.
